sentences: Do you like stories?
你喜欢听故事吗？
I want to tell you a true story.
我要告诉你一个真实的故事。
It happened to a friend of mine a year ago.
这是一年前发生在我的一个朋友身上的故事。
While my friend, George, was reading in bed,
当我的朋友乔治在床上看书时。
Two thieves climbed into his kitchen.
两个小偷爬进了他的厨房。
After they had entered the house,
他们进到屋里后。
They went into the dining room.
走进了饭厅。
It was very dark, so they turned on a torch.
饭厅很暗，于是他们打开了手电筒。
Suddenly, they heard a voice behind them. 'What's up? What's up?' someone called.
突然他们听到身后有声音。「什么事？什么事？」有人叫着。
The thieves dropped the torch and ran away as quickly as they could.
小偷扔下了手电筒，飞快地逃走了。
George heard the noise and came downstairs quickly.
乔治听到了响声，迅速地下了楼。
He turned on the light, but he couldn't see anyone. The thieves had already gone.
他开了灯，但不见一个人。小偷逃走了。
But George's parrot, Henry, was still there.
但是乔治的鹦鹉亨利仍在那里。
What's up, George?
「什么事，乔治？」
Nothing, Henry.
「没事，亨利。」
George said and smiled.
乔治笑着说。
Go back to sleep.
「接着睡觉吧。」
